questions.question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

She asked her brother if he had liked her gift.

options.text: She said to her brother, “Have you like her gift?”
She said to her brother, “Do you liked her gift?”
She said to her brother, “Did you liked my gift?”
She said to her brother, “Did you like my gift?”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'She said to her brother, “Did you like my gift?”'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While converting an **interrogative sentence from indirect speech to direct speech**, we need to follow the given steps-

 
 
• **'Asked'** is changed to **'said to'.**
 
• **A comma (,) and inverted commas (" ")** are used in place of **'if'.**
 
• The** past perfect tense** is changed to **either simple past or present perfect tense.**
 
• **'Did + v1'** is used in the **simple past tense** and **'have + v3'** is used in the **present perfect tense.**
 
• **3rd person** (**he**) is changed into '**you'** and **'her'** is changed into **'she'** i.e. according to the **object** (brother) and the **subject** (she) of the **reporting verb**.

 
 
 

**The final sentence-** *She said to her brother, “Did you like my gift?”*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• While changing the narration of an** interrogative sentence**, we need to follow the given steps-

 
 
• The conjunction **‘if’** should be used in place of a comma (,) and inverted commas (“ ”).
 
• **'Question mark (?)' **is changed to** full stop (.).**
 
• **‘Said to’ **will be changed into **‘asked’.**
 
• Tense and pronouns are changed accordingly.

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

The little boy complained me about his careless nanny.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'complained me'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Complain'** is a verb which means **"​to say that you are annoyed, unhappy or not satisfied about somebody/something".**

 
 
• **E.g**. Poor residents complained to the police.
 
 
 
• 'Complain' is followed by the preposition** 'to'**, when the person to whom you are complaining is mentioned.
 
 
• **E.g.** I **complained to** the customer service representative.
 
 
 
• According to the rule and example that are given above,** 'complained to me'** will be used instead of** 'complained me'.**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The little boy **complained to me **about his careless nanny.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Difference between complain and complaint-**

 
 
• **'Complain'** is a **verb*** *which means "​to say that you are annoyed, unhappy or not satisfied about somebody/something".

 
 
• **E.g.** Tourists **complained** about the lack of toilet facilities in the area.
 
 
 
• **'Complaint'** is a **noun** which means "a statement that somebody makes saying that they are not satisfied".
 
 
• **E.g.** The most common **complaint **is about poor service.

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The villagers were harvesting the crop with great enthusiasm.

options.text: The crop is being harvest by the villagers with great enthusiasm.
The crop was harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.
The crop was being harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.
The crop has been harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The crop was being harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of an **assertive sentence**.

 
 
• Find the **subject and object** of the sentence and **exchange their places**; make changes in their **cases** as well if subject and object are **pronouns**.
 
• Use preposition **by** before agent. (the villagers)
 
• Use helping verb in passive form according to the tense of active form. **(Past continuous - was/were + being)**
 
• Always use the **third form** of the main verb in passive form.
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 ​
 
 

**Following these steps, we finally get-** *The crop was being harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **Assertive sentence** is the type of sentence that declares or asserts a statement, feeling, opinion, incident, event, history, or anything.
 
• An assertive sentence ends with a** full stop (.).**
 
• Assertive sentences can be either affirmative or negative.
 
 
• **E.g.** Indian cricket team played well in the last match.

• Hence, **option 4 **is the correct answer.

 

**The correct answer-** *The queen produces fertile daughter workers.*

• **Let's know the meanings of the important words-**

 
 
• **Sterile-** not able to produce children or young animals.
 
• **Fertile-** that can produce babies, young animals, fruit or new plants.
